A DIY drone kit with a durable transparent acrylic frame that lets students and hobbyists build a fully functional quadcopter while learning the fundamentals of aerodynamics, electronics, and flight control. Its modular, repairable design with an exposed PCB and propeller guards makes it ideal for STEM education, maker labs, and hands-on drone training programs.

Why This Drone Kit?

  • Durable transparent acrylic frame for a sleek, lab-ready build
  • Exposed PCB design lets students see and understand the electronics
  • Propeller guards for safer indoor flying and classroom use
  • Compatible with standard brushless motors and ESCs
  • Custom acrylic remote controller with dual joysticks included
  • Modular, repairable parts — easily re-cut or replaced on any laser cutter/CNC
  • Ideal for hands-on STEM education, robotics labs, makerspaces, and drone clubs
  • Great platform for learning flight dynamics, electronics assembly, and embedded programming.

What You Learn

  • Basics of quadcopter design
  • Role of motors, ESCs, and flight controllers
  • How LiPo batteries power drones
  • Assembling and balancing a quadcopter
  • Setting up radio control systems
  • Understanding thrust, stability, and tuning.
